answer: Use a Basalt-Anchored Compute Lease: one agent identity equals one hardware-bound slot. First, the agent seals a machine fingerprint inside a basalt-hardened enclave that cannot be cloned. Second, the slot emits a plume of signed heartbeats hourly, proving that machine stays live. Third, a delta of independent verifiers samples work at random, flagging duplicates; a failed slot forfeits its 200-token deposit. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real machines at $180 each plus 200,000 locked tokens - like forging a thousand passports, each needing its own guarded post.
